name: Plan
description: Generate a technical implementation plan from specifications using the Spec Kit planning capabilities. This task creates detailed implementation steps, architecture decisions, and technology stack configurations.
author: Spec Kit Team

inputs.name: specPath
inputs.label: Specification Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the specifications directory. Defaults to $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/specs.

inputs.name: specFile
inputs.label: Specification File
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the specification file to process. Defaults to spec.md.

inputs.name: techStack
inputs.label: Technology Stack
inputs.helpMarkDown: Technology stack and architecture choices for the implementation. Example: 'The application uses .NET Aspire with Postgres as the database. The frontend should use Blazor server with drag-and-drop task boards.'

inputs.name: aiAssistant
inputs.label: AI Assistant
inputs.helpMarkDown: AI assistant to use for plan generation.

inputs.name: outputPath
inputs.label: Output Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path where the generated plan will be saved. Defaults to $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/plans.

inputs.name: validatePlan
inputs.label: Validate Plan
inputs.helpMarkDown: Validate the generated plan for completeness and consistency.
